entities.name: Marek
entities.description: A Vedalken soldier, commander of Lord Pontifex's elite guard on Mirrodin, who turned against Pontifex and died killing him.

entities.name: Pontifex
entities.description: Former Synod leader and Marek's master who betrayed Memnarch's orders.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Elf pursued across Mirrodin; saved by Marek.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Ruler who ordered Glissa brought to his lair.

entities.name: Kaldra
entities.description: Rose from beneath Geth's throne room, forcing the vedalken to flee.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Owner of the throne room beneath which Kaldra rose.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: Region traveled to reach the Vault of Whispers.

entities.name: Vault of Whispers
entities.description: Site of a second attack on Glissa's party.

entities.name: Mirrodin's Core
entities.description: Where Pontifex and Marek killed each other.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Blue-skinned people of Mirrodin to which Marek and Pontifex belong.

events.summary: Marek chases Glissa with his Master to bring her to Memnarch.
events.quote: With his Master, he chased Glissa across Mirrodin to bring her to Memnarch .

events.summary: In the Razor Fields Pontifex orders Marek to kill Glissa; Marek swings but Bruenna blocks, to his relief.
events.quote: he was relieved when his attack was blocked by the neurok Bruenna

events.summary: At the Vault of Whispers Kaldra emerges from beneath Geth's throne room and drives the vedalken back.
events.quote: they were forced back by the emergence of Kaldra

events.summary: Marek realizes Pontifex has betrayed Memnarch and intervenes to save Glissa's life.
events.quote: Marek intervened and saved her life

events.summary: Marek and Pontifex kill each other.
events.quote: Thus, the two former friends ended up killing each other.

relations.note: Commander of his elite guard, until he turned against him
relations.quote: the commander of Lord Pontifex 's elite guard on Mirrodin

relations.note: Slashed his throat with his halberd
relations.quote: Marek at the same time reacted by slashing Pontifex's throat with his halberd

relations.note: Launched his blades into Marek's body
relations.quote: Pontifex ruled away and launched his blades into Marek's body, killing him
